notes.content:
Hello guys, I just updated Sponchies!

notes.title: Sponchies - FREE to Play!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30749945/760773367293f9e99386ebf6b4593d41e73275ab.png[/img]

I've been thinking a lot about this for a while now, and I feel like this is the right decision.

Sponchies is my second game, I spent over a year making it... it was a great learning experience for me to grow as a developer, I really learned a lot. But unfortunately it was a commercial failure, I don't know if it was the wrong timing or the game wasn't unique enough to stand out from the many games that are being released on Steam on a daily basis. (or maybe it's just because it had a 0 marketing budget)

I worked many many hours on this game, and it makes me sad that no one is playing it, but it never really had a chance with no marketing and no exposure. So hopefully if I make it FREE maybe some people may give it a try and enjoy playing it.

Just to make it clear, this is a not going to be FREE to play with in-game purchases or anything like that, Sponchies is going to be complety FREE. As a game developer you want your games to be played as much as possible and be enjoyed by many people.

Hopefully you might give Sponchies a try! and maybe tell your friends.

NOTE* Making Sponchies FREE won't happen instantly but I'll update this note when it's available to dowload for free. ETA 1 week

notes.title: Sponchies: Update 5.5.0 Final - Bug FREE
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30749945/5c73d73f3eab83811adaec31fb084ae44b882ebb.png[/img]

Update 5.5.0 is now live for Sponchies, in this update I crushed all the bugs in the game.

The game is completely bug free now, I had to rebuild the collision system entirely so the Sponchies won't get stuck inside the walls anymore.

The difficulty in many levels was rebalanced, I think is perfect now.

As always if you happen to find a new bug, please let me know so I can fix it.

If you are enjoying Sponchies, please support me by writting a review here in Steam, that really helps! Thanks ːs_happyː

[u] Edited 10/30/17:[/u] ------------------------------------------------------------

[b] In update "5.5.1" I reworked and improved the wall jump system, hopefully this will help new and keyboard players.[/b] 

[u] Edited 11/01/17:[/u] ------------------------------------------------------------

[b] Update 5.5.3:

-Improved the wall jumping system even more (I think it's perfect now)
-Added wall jumping instructions in LVL 4[/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/593670/Sponchies/

notes.title: Update v.5.4.8
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30749945/a07b15089ad0f7960d7a02dcd51c693554005eaf.png[/img]

Hello guys, I just updated Sponchies and fixed some bugs. 

This is a pretty solid patch, but if you still find any hidden bugs please let me know so I can fix them right away.

If you are enjoying Sponchies, please consider taking a couple minutes of your time to drop a review here on Steam that really goes a long way! I could really use the support.

Patch notes:
-Fixed pause menu, it no longer closes when you open the steam overlay
-In some levels the player was getting stuck inside some canons.
-In some levels the playes was getting stuck inside the walls.
-Fixed collison issues
-Fixed sound & music issues
+ many little tiny bugs.
